biography_english:
A Galgastani who serves the Kingdom of Galgastan. He was consul to Almorica while it was under Galgastani control; however, it appears he left his duties to a knight in his service, and was rarely seen in public.
  He did not return to Coritanae following the fall of Almorica Castle.

  No regreso a Coritanae tras la caida del Castillo de Almorica.

biography_english: A Galgastani necromancer who served the Kingdom of Galgastan. After using the Ring of the Dead to transform himself into a lich, the Dark drew him to the depths of the Palace of the Dead. The Resistance finally defeated him and he became one with the Dark, vanishing from the land.

biography_english:
A Galgastani necromancer who once served the Kingdom of Galgastan. His whereabouts since the downfall of the Kingdom were not known until he was discovered continuing his nefarious experiments on Exeter.
  He believed that death could be cheated and immortality achieved, but none shared his convictions. It is said he twice resurrected family members who had departed the mortal coil.
  He was defeated in a skirmish with {hero}, but then transformed into a lich and escaped.
biography_spanish:
Un nigromante Galgastani que sirvio al Reino de Galgastan. Su paradero tras la caida del Reino se ignoraba hasta que fue descubierto continuando sus viles experimentos en Exeter.
  Creia que la muerte se podia burlar y alcanzar la inmortalidad, pero nadie compartia sus convicciones. Se dice que resucito dos veces a familiares que habian dejado el mundo terrenal.
  Fue derrotado en una escaramuza con {hero}, pero se transformo en liche y huyo.

biography_english:
Leader of the Kingdom of Galgastan. After war broke out, he established a realm ruled by the descendant of Count Orlandeau, a former lord of Coritanae. He installed himself as regent under the pretense of guiding the young lord. He started the blood war to suppress the Walister and take the southern half of Valeria for his own. Within a few months he crushed the Walister forces and captured their leader, Duke Ronwey.
  Even fellow Galgastani voiced concern at his high-handed policies, but all were soon silenced. He is a ruthless and calculating man.
biography_spanish:
Lider del Reino de Galgastan. Tras estallar la guerra, creo un reino gobernado por el descendiente del conde Orlandeau, antiguo lord de Coritanae. Se nombro regente con el pretexto de guiar al joven lord. Inicio la guerra sangrienta para reprimir a los Walister y tomar la mitad sur de Valeria. En pocos meses aplasto a los Walister y capturo a su lider, el duque Ronwey.
  Incluso otros Galgastani criticaron sus autoritarias politicas, pero todos fueron silenciados pronto. Es un hombre despiadado y calculador.

biography_english:
Former leader of the Kingdom of Galgastan. After war broke out, he established a realm ruled by the descendant of Count Orlandeau, a former lord of Coritanae. He installed himself as regent under the pretense of guiding the young lord. He started the blood war to suppress the Walister and take the southern half of Valeria for his own. Within a few months he crushed the Walister forces and captured their leader, Duke Ronwey.
  However, he was in turn defeated by the Walister Resistance after the duke's liberation. He was executed following his capture.

En pocos meses aplasto a los Walister y capturo a su lider, el duque Ronwey.
  Sin embargo, fue derrotado por la Resistencia Walister tras la liberacion del duque. Fue ejecutado tras su captura.

biography_english:
Former leader of the Kingdom of Galgastan. After war broke out, he established a realm ruled by the descendant of Count Orlandeau, a former lord of Coritanae. He installed himself as regent under the pretense of guiding the young lord. He started the blood war to suppress the Walister and take the southern half of Valeria for his own. Within a few months he crushed the Walister forces and captured their leader, Duke Ronwey.
  Even fellow Galgastani voiced concern at his high-handed policies, and some even rose against him. This internal strife paved the way for the Walister Resistance to invade Galgastan.
  The beleaguered Hierophant took his own life when the Resistance assailed Coritanae Keep.

  Incluso otros Galgastani criticaron sus autoritarias politicas, y algunos hasta se alzaron contra el. Esta lucha interna abrio el camino para que la Resistencia Walister invadiera Galgastan.
  El acorralado Jerarca se quito la vida cuando la Resistencia asalto el Castillo de Coritanae.

biography_english:
A Galgastani who once led the Knights of Galgastan.
  He served directly under Balbatos, hunting down the Hierophant's enemies at home and suppressing the Walister.
  After the Hierophant's death he continued to launch strikes together with other Galgastani remnants. He captured Coritanae Keep from the Resistance, and is now barricaded inside.
